stance_target: Why vanilla NSA underperforms at small GQA group sizes
scope_conditions: Method section; warp-level MMA requires >=8 on Hopper and Triton thread-block tiles >=16
quoted_support: when GQA group size is not sufficiently large, NSA selected attention kernel must pad data to satisfy hardware requirements on the matrix dimensions of matrix multiplication ... FSA exchanges the kernel loop order of original NSA kernel design
